title: Time-travelling Nordic humans manipulating history

tellings.quote: continuity. We are dealing with people who achieved time travel at some point.

plain: Some of the beings people report, tall, fair humans often called "Nordics", are said to be humans who mastered time travel at some point, around 2050, and who now move between Earth, Mars and the Moon and steer history. The philosopher Jason Jorjani lays out this idea as his own reading, drawing on a work called Closer Encounters. If true, it would mean some visitors are really our own descendants changing our past.
